title: Ciphertext adjacent-contrast non-anchor position prior
rationale: This lane predeclares a ciphertext-only adjacent-contrast rule before scoring any new source-backed observations. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or prior public-fragment structure screens.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched at positions selected by a predeclared adjacent-ciphertext contrast rule before any candidate-word, route, key-material, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: K4 ciphertext letters only, with positions interpreted as one-based absolute ciphertext positions.
Predeclared adjacent-contrast rule over neighboring ciphertext symbol values in the Kryptos alphabet.
A fixed top-position selection rule emitted before any independent observation scoring.
evaluation_inputs: Future independently source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, notes, and rationale declared before scoring.
A committed prediction artifact generated from the adjacent-contrast rule before evaluating independent observations.
Observation files whose scored positions were not used to construct or tune the adjacent-contrast prediction artifact.
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
ciphertext-symbol shuffle baseline preserving K4 length and alphabet membership
known public-anchor positions used only as an exclusion mask, not as scoring evidence or tuning input
multiple-comparison correction across any predeclared contrast thresholds
archive validation requiring preregistration, prediction artifact, source-backed observation file, command metadata, and non-promotion caveat
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
